text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with a general status update on the three theatres (Sony Centre for the Performing Arts, St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts, Toronto Centre for the Arts).

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Requested the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto to develop an action plan to manage and mitigate risk and report through the Managed Risk Programming Committee in time to report to the September 20, 2018 Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto meeting.
